title: Incremental CodeQL
content: The goal of the Incremental CodeQL project is to investigate the potential for incrementalization to improve the performance of CodeQL query evaluation. Instead of having to re-analyze the whole code base from scratch, incremental evaluation reuses the previously computed analysis results and only re-analyzes the parts of the code base that are affected by a program change. This approach can lead to significant performance speed-ups without the need to make any changes to the analysis implementation.
